Name: Actus ag
Company description: A full-service tax firm dedicated to Entrepreneurs, Investors & Corporates in Liechtenstein with strong partners around the world.  We connect the traditional regulatory world with the decentralized tech world: We structure the next generation of powerhouses!  We are one of the pioneers in the tax analysis of digital business models, blockchain-based transactions, tokens and ICOs in the DACHLI Region.  Our clients from the blockchain or FinTech industry are internationally renowned companies and range from innovative startups from Crypto Valley to wealthy crypto enthusiasts and professional investors.  #challenge today & change tomorrow

Name: Bank Frick
Company description: Bank Frick specialises in banking for intermediaries. We provide a fully integrated offering of classic banking and blockchain banking services. Our clients include fintechs, asset managers, payment service providers, family offices, fund promoters, pension funds and fiduciaries. In addition to our proven basic services, Bank Frick’s classic banking offerings cover services for funds and issues, focusing on formulating European (AIF, UCITS) and national fund solutions. In the capital market sector, we develop tailored financial products for intermediaries and supports them along the whole issue process, acting also as a custodian bank.  Bank Frick is one of Europe’s pioneers of the regulated blockchain banking sector. As well as offering trading and custodian services for crypto assets, we support token sales and develop tailored crypto structuring solutions for intermediaries.  Bank Frick is the only Liechtenstein bank with acquiring licences from Visa and MasterCard to process card payments globally for payment service providers and their online merchants. For more details visit frick.ly/imprint.

Name: Digital Finance Forum Liechtenstein
Company description: Das Digital Finance Forum ist die neue Leuchtturm-Veranstaltung für den Finanzplatz Liechtenstein. Die Tagung fokussiert auf moderne Finanztechnologien und digitale Transformation. Am Digital Finance Forum vernetzen sich Entscheidungsträger aus der Finanzbranche mit Innovatoren und Fintech-Startups. Das Programm beinhaltet hochkarätige Keynotes und Panels mit Visionären und Spezialisten aus der Praxis ebenso wie Breakout-Sessions mit konkreten Best-practice-Beispielen.

Name: Fintech.li Conference
Company description: Fintech.li 2023 is about "Drawing the dots - shaping the NEXT HUMAN agenda": We discuss the latest trends, regulations, and opportunities but also provide relevant insights into Defi, DAOs, Stablecoins, Refi, DeSci (incl. Longevity), and web3 Regulation - fintech.li connect the dots in Liechtenstein 🇱🇮👋 About Fintech.li Conference: Based on the advancing digitalization of the financial industry, fintech.li was founded in 2015, where it also has had its first Conference. From there the focus of the conference shifted to a more web3 first approach. In September 2016, the Conference was a two-day event, took place. It was organized in cooperation with the Financial Market Authority of Liechtenstein and attracted more than 250 people. Since 2017 the conference developed into a place to be for international leaders from all around the world in the Web3 & FinTech  Ecosystem. Also, the Government of the Principality of Liechtenstein took over the patronage of the fintech.li Conference. Fintech.li 2023 is where the most powerful conversations and connections happen.

Name: Floin
Company description: Floin is a FinTech startup, creating a fully regulated home for digital assets to provide a safe and enjoyable experience of buying, selling, and storing tokens. This new ecosystem is complemented by a revolutionary marketplace where you can find the most exciting tokenized project.

Name: LCX
Company description: LCX.com is a secure and compliant platform for buying, selling, transferring, and storing digital currency. The LCX Exchange is a regulated trading venue offering a range of digital currencies. LCX is a proud member of the World Economic Forum's Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution. LCX is a fintech company that focuses on the tokenization of assets, utility and security token offerings, and advanced trading tools. LCX, the Liechtenstein Cryptoassets Exchange, is based in Liechtenstein, operates in accordance with the new blockchain laws, and has introduced a comprehensive crypto compliance suite. In 2020, LCX gained regulatory approval for 8 blockchain-related registrations by the Financial Market Authority. LCX AG was founded in 2018 with headquarters in Vaduz (Liechtenstein) and branches in Crypto Valley Zug (Switzerland) and New Delhi (India).

Name: Seed X Liechtenstein AG
Company description: Seed X Liechtenstein AG is a Venture Capital Firm based in Liechtenstein. We invest in pre-Seed, Seed and Series A ventures in Europe with a focus on Fintech, Insurtech, Proptech and Legaltech.
